Software Engineer, Systems — Cloudflare

Location: Remote (US)
Seniority: 0-2 years experience

About the role:
We are looking for a Software Engineer to work on high-performance systems close to the
metal. You will build networking and proxy infrastructure that serves millions of requests
per second, with a focus on Linux, eBPF, and observability.

Requirements:
- Strong programming skills in Go or C/C++
- Experience with Linux systems programming
- Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing)
- Interest in eBPF, performance profiling, or kernel-adjacent tooling

Preferred:
- Rust experience
- Prior work on CDN, reverse proxies, or edge computing
- Contributions to open-source systems software

Domain: systems infrastructure, networking, performance
